name: Ramah

identification.note: A Benjaminite town, distinct from Ramathaim-zophim (Samuel's hometown, also sometimes called Ramah) and from Ramah of Naphtali (Joshua 19:36).

description: A town near which Samuel made his home for part of his judging circuit (1 Samuel 7:17), fortified by King Baasha of Israel against Judah before Asa had it dismantled (1 Kings 15:17-22).
